name: grub-roulette
description: A quirky, gamified meal picker. List some ideas, spin the wheel, eat.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @grub/api" "npm run dev -w @grub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @grub/web && npm run build -w @grub/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
